model.line: No box of its own: the hall drawn at this point stands for the gate in the 3D view.

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Gate on the north side of Qichun Yuan. First character read with some doubt. Read by two readers as 蒨园门, the Changchun side; not 绮园门.

sources.text: Plan of the Yuanmingyuan Imperial Garden-Palace, unknown artist, three hanging scrolls, ink and colour on paper, 177 × 253 cm together
